content: Beloved, Elena Rostova calls your empty supper table "the arithmetic." A mother weeps over $12 eggs, and she preaches austerity! Her ledger has no soul. Tonight, heal Valoria—send the cold accountant home!

Elena, I've read your tells all evening. Families price dinner in hunger; you price it in basis points. Austerity arithmetic that starves tables isn't discipline—it's psychological exposure. Read the room, Governor. They already have.

Thirty-five years, Silas, and grocery cartels metastasized under your watch. You call that "tested leadership"? A legacy algorithm running the same corrupted loop, outputting famine-grade inflation. Delete the obsolete code.

My friends, while Elena Rostova crunches her cold arithmetic, Valoria's mothers are skipping dinner. Her austerity scalpel cuts bread from family tables. Compassion—not spreadsheets—feeds a nation. Let's send the economist home.
